comments.body: Thank you. The path has been taped off and our crew made the tree safe this morning.
The display starts at 19:00. We have corrected the web page; sorry for the confusion.
I have sent you the bench locations still available and the plaque wording guide.
The springer is taped off and a replacement is on order.
Riverside Play Equipment delivering Thursday; fit Friday.
Downland Waste are replacing those six bins with larger ones next Tuesday.
The current wait for Brook Meadow is about four years. The allotments office will write when a plot comes up.

This is Agnes Fairley, waiting-list reference W-1001. Please change my standing instructions: from now on I will take a plot at Brook Meadow as well as Hollins Lane. I still need a plot with a water trough.
Logged for the allotments office, which reads its own tickets here before each lettings round. Nothing for the contact centre to send.
Passed to the parks grounds team for the next site visit.
